applications.page.title: Startup Apps
applications.page.subtitle: Manage which apps, folders and web pages start with Windows. Click Scan Desktop and pick icons, use Browse for files, or use Choose Folder; selected items go straight into the plan and stay there.
applications.page.short: Manage the apps, folders and web pages that start with Windows.

applications.tip.scanDesktop.description: Read desktop items for selection without changing the plan.
applications.tip.addSelected.description: Copy this startup plan into Startup & Restore as a new work profile.
applications.tip.addSelected.suggestion: The plan name is copied too; duplicate names get a numeric suffix.
applications.tip.browseFiles.description: Choose files to add to the current plan.
applications.tip.browseFolder.descriptio: Choose a folder to add to the current plan.
applications.tip.restoreNow.description: Start the checked items in the current plan in order.
applications.tip.restoreNow.suggestion: The pre-start wait is honored (0 starts immediately); items already open are skipped, and the restore card can cancel.
applications.tip.searchPlan.description: Find existing startup plans by name or save time.
applications.tip.searchPlan.suggestion: Click a result to switch to it.
applications.tip.appendTime.description: Append time zone + current time to the plan name; click again to update only the time.
applications.tip.searchResults.name: Search scan results
applications.tip.searchResults.descripti: Filter scanned items by name or path.
applications.tip.searchResults.suggestio: A few characters are enough; no need to scroll.
applications.tip.addChecked.description: Add the checked items to the current plan.
applications.tip.closeScan.description: Close scan results; items already added to the plan are unaffected.
applications.tip.desktopSelection.name: Select desktop item
applications.tip.desktopSelection.descri: After selecting, click Add to Current Plan.
applications.tip.desktopSelection.help: Check it, then click Add to Current Plan; only then does it enter the startup list.
applications.tip.desktopOpen.name: Open desktop item
applications.tip.desktopOpen.help: Open this desktop item immediately without adding it to the startup plan.
applications.tip.desktopPick.description: Check it before adding to the plan.
applications.tip.planExpand.name: Expand or collapse plan
applications.tip.planExpand.description: Show or hide the items in this startup plan.
applications.tip.itemDelete.name: Delete item
applications.tip.itemDelete.description: Remove this item from the startup plan (files on disk are kept); press Ctrl+Z to undo.
applications.tip.planNamePlain.descripti: Double-click to rename (Enter confirms, Esc cancels); click to switch the current plan; drag the title to reorder plans.
applications.tip.planMove.name: Hold to move
applications.tip.planMove.description: Hold and drag here to reorder startup plans; drop onto the middle of another plan card to merge into it.
applications.tip.planCopy.name: Add to Startup & Restore (this plan)
applications.tip.planCopy.description: Copy the whole plan into Startup & Restore as a new profile (the name comes along).
applications.tip.planRestore.name: Restore this plan
applications.tip.planRestore.description: Restore the items on this card; click Cancel Restore on the restore card to stop.
applications.tip.planDelete.name: Delete plan
applications.tip.planDelete.description: Delete this plan; only the list is removed, not files on disk.
applications.tip.groupEnable.name: Start the whole group
applications.tip.groupEnable.description: Unchecked: skip the whole browser window/folder at startup but keep it in the plan.
applications.tip.groupGrip.name: Hold to drag and reorder
applications.tip.groupGrip.description: Hold and drag this whole group (with all children); drop it on another plan card to move the group.
applications.tip.groupGrip.suggestion: You can also drag the title directly.
applications.tip.itemEnable.name: Start this item
applications.tip.itemEnable.description: Unchecked: skip this item at startup but keep it in the plan.
applications.tip.itemGrip.description: Hold and drag this item to change startup order; you can also hold Shift and drag the whole row.
applications.tip.planSavedAt.empty: This startup plan has no saved-time record yet.
